## 中文

### 新增与调整

- 新增 Y2JB Autoloader 的按需下载和 FTP 安装，提供 [v0.9.1 正式版](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-y2jb-autoloader/releases/tag/v0.9.1-36381e4) 与 [v1.0.0-dev-794049f Relapse 测试版](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-y2jb-autoloader/releases/tag/v1.0.0-dev-794049f)。两个版本独立缓存；下载文件大小及 SHA-256 已核对 GitHub 发布附件元数据。
- 安装时先上传临时文件，通过 FTP 回读完整文件校验 SHA-256，再备份并替换对应 YouTube 应用的 `download0.dat`。界面显示安装阶段、目标路径、备份及需要检查的临时文件；中断时尝试清理或恢复，并如实报告无法确认的结果。
- 当前插件页面增加四个功能分类：游戏传输与文件管理、游戏安装与挂载、游戏运行支持、入口与插件管理。八个插件卡片都有用途说明；区分 YouTube / WebKit 启动入口与 Payload Manager 的插件管理职责。
- 同步中英文界面、README 和详细指南，明确 FTP 安装准备条件、正式版与测试版区别，以及文件安装完成和 PS5 实际执行的不同状态。

### 使用方法与兼容性

先完成首次破解，按上游要求准备兼容的 YouTube、账号及更新阻止设置，并启动可访问 `/user/download` 的 FTP 服务。在“安装插件 → 入口与插件管理 → Y2JB Autoloader”选择版本、实际安装的 YouTube 应用 ID 和 FTP 端口，下载后完全关闭 YouTube，确认准备完成，再点击“通过 FTP 安装”。仅下载文件不会修改 PS5。

安装后在 PS5 打开 YouTube 验证。没有 `autoload.txt` 时启动内置 Payload Manager；存在该文件时按配置加载。电脑已下载的其他插件不会自动加入自动加载列表。安装器保留已有自动加载配置，不安装 YouTube 或修改账号；安装及回读各传输约 321 MiB，并需要足够空间保留原数据备份。每次重启仍需运行入口，这不是永久破解。

v0.9.1 未集成 Relapse；12.70 以上（包括 13.60）仍需另一个适用的内核漏洞。Relapse 测试版的作者标注目标固件 10.20–13.60，但要求进一步测试。本项目尚未实机验证 Y2JB 的固件兼容性、安装后执行或插件组合，也未确认当前 Kstuff FPKG 测试版在 13.40 / 13.60 的游戏兼容性。文件校验、FTP 安装完成或 ELF 发送完成均不能保证游戏可运行，也未验证能修复游戏启动黑屏。

替换结果无法确认时，请先关闭 YouTube，通过 FTP 检查界面给出的目标、备份及临时路径，再决定恢复或重试；不要连续重复安装。连接中断时清理或恢复也可能失败，需手动检查。

### 验证与发布包

`npm ci`、69 项自动化测试及差异格式检查通过。Windows Electron 界面使用模拟接口验证了四类八个插件、中英文切换、Y2JB 版本与操作绑定、安装条件确认、无效端口拒绝、安装时参数锁定以及目标和备份提示；未连接 PS5。FTP 模拟服务测试覆盖回读校验、备份保留、安装中断、取消及恢复。三平台构建和测试结果见本次标签对应的 Actions；本地未执行 macOS 人工界面验证。

Windows x64 提供安装版与便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP，并附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

本项目仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。构建包不附带网页资源、第三方 ELF、Y2JB 下载数据或游戏内容；第三方资源由用户主动下载并遵守其许可。软件按现状提供，不保证效果，使用者承担自身操作责任；相关权利归第三方所有。完整边界与免责声明见 README。

## English

### Additions and updates

- Add user-initiated downloads and FTP installation for Y2JB Autoloader, with [v0.9.1 stable](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-y2jb-autoloader/releases/tag/v0.9.1-36381e4) and the [v1.0.0-dev-794049f Relapse test release](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-y2jb-autoloader/releases/tag/v1.0.0-dev-794049f). Versions have separate caches; pinned sizes and SHA-256 hashes match GitHub release asset metadata.
- Upload to a staging file, read the entire file back over FTP to verify SHA-256, then back up and replace the selected YouTube app's `download0.dat`. The interface reports installation stages, destination, backup and any staging path requiring inspection. Interrupted operations attempt cleanup or recovery and report unconfirmed results explicitly.
- Organize the existing plugin page into four categories: game transfer and file management, game installation and mounting, game runtime support, and entry and payload management. All eight plugin cards explain their purpose, including the distinction between YouTube / WebKit entry points and Payload Manager.
- Update English and Chinese interface text, README files and detailed guides with FTP preparation requirements, version differences, and separate file-installation and PS5-execution results.

### Usage and compatibility

Complete the initial jailbreak, prepare a compatible YouTube app, account and update blocking as documented upstream, and start an FTP service with access to `/user/download`. Under “Install components → Entry and payload management → Y2JB Autoloader,” select the version, installed YouTube title ID and FTP port. Download the data, fully close YouTube, confirm preparation, then click “Install through FTP.” Downloading alone does not change the PS5.

Open YouTube on PS5 to verify operation. Without `autoload.txt`, the bundled Payload Manager starts; when that file exists, payloads load according to its configuration. Other components downloaded on the PC are not automatically added to autoload. Existing autoload configuration is preserved; the installer does not install YouTube or change accounts. Upload and readback each transfer about 321 MiB, and retaining the original backup requires sufficient free space. The entry point still needs to run after every restart; this is not a permanent jailbreak.

v0.9.1 does not include Relapse; firmware above 12.70, including 13.60, still needs another applicable kernel exploit. The Relapse test-release author lists target firmware 10.20–13.60 but requests further testing. This project has not hardware-tested Y2JB firmware compatibility, execution after installation or payload combinations. Gameplay with the current Kstuff FPKG test version on 13.40 / 13.60 also remains unverified. File integrity, completed FTP installation or completed ELF delivery does not guarantee gameplay or establish a fix for launch black screens.

If replacement is unconfirmed, close YouTube and inspect the destination, backup and staging paths shown in the interface over FTP before restoring or retrying. Avoid repeated installation while the result is unknown. Cleanup and recovery may also fail after a disconnection and require manual inspection.

### Verification and packages

`npm ci`, all 69 automated tests and diff formatting checks pass. Windows Electron checks with mocked APIs cover four categories and eight plugins, language switching, Y2JB version and action routing, preparation confirmation, invalid ports, locked installation settings, and destination and backup feedback; they do not connect to PS5. Mock FTP tests cover readback verification, backup preservation, interruption, cancellation and recovery. Build and test results for all three platforms are available in the Actions run for this tag; local manual macOS interface testing was not performed.

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages. macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages, with `SHA256SUMS.txt` supplied. All packages are unsigned; macOS packages are not notarized.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. Builds do not bundle web resources, third-party ELFs, Y2JB download data or game content. Third-party downloads require user action and remain subject to their licenses. The software is provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their actions, and third-party rights remain with their owners. See the README for the full boundaries and disclaimer.
